0.17.0-beta.1.title: Cross-platform capability beta
0.17.0-beta.1.summary: Introduces capability-aware Windows, macOS, Linux X11, and Linux Wayland behavior while keeping unsupported input paths visibly disabled.
changes: Added shared runtime capability reporting across supported desktop environments
Added macOS Accessibility permission checks and foreground-input support
Added Linux session detection and X11 foreground-input support
Kept Wayland in Simulation mode where unrestricted input is unavailable
limitations: Only the Windows x64 package was published for this build

0.18.0-beta.1.title: Cross-platform packaging beta
0.18.0-beta.1.summary: Adds repeatable Windows, Linux, and Universal 2 macOS packaging with checksums, manifests, diagnostics, themes, and a refreshed AutoQuill identity.
changes: Added Windows x64, Linux x64, and Universal 2 macOS packages
Added per-platform manifests and SHA-256 checksums
Added Dark, Light, and System themes with reduced-motion support
Added privacy-safe diagnostics and best-effort tray controls
limitations: macOS and Linux are unverified previews rather than physically tested releases
The macOS package is unsigned and unnotarized
Linux Real Typing is experimental on X11; Wayland remains Simulation-only

0.19.0-beta.1.title: UI reliability beta
0.19.0-beta.1.summary: Improves responsive layout containment, keyboard focus, accessible controls, modal behavior, contrast, and repeatable Windows UI verification.
changes: Prevented narrow layouts from painting over the fixed header
Contained keyboard focus within active modal surfaces
Added stable accessibility names and editable-value automation support
Improved dark-theme contrast and Windows UI acceptance coverage
limitations: All platform packages remain unsigned beta builds
macOS and Linux are unverified previews rather than physically tested releases
Linux Real Typing is experimental on X11; Wayland remains Simulation-only
